name: ACME Digital Goods
line: Typefaces, pattern packs and studio tools from a two-person foundry in Leeds, delivered as files.

offers.name: Bracken Display, glyph set
offers.about: A display face for headlines and posters, delivered as an SVG specimen with the full working glyph set drawn as vector outlines, plus a single-studio desktop licence.

terms.licence: Single-studio licence: installed on up to five machines within one studio. You may not resell, lend or redistribute the glyph outlines.
terms.deliverables: One SVG file with the specimen sheet and glyph outlines, delivered at purchase.
terms.upgrades: Minor revisions of the face are free within 12 months.

offers.name: Moor pattern pack, 12 tiles
offers.about: Twelve seamless vector pattern tiles drawn from the Yorkshire moors: heather, gritstone, peat water and sheep-worn paths. Delivered as one SVG sheet, each tile ready to lift into your own work.

terms.licence: You may use the tiles in client work and printed or digital products without limit. You may not resell or redistribute the tiles as patterns.
terms.deliverables: One SVG file with twelve seamless tiles, delivered at purchase.
terms.refunds: A download cannot be returned, so it is not refunded.

offers.name: North Palettes dataset
offers.about: Forty colour palettes sampled from northern English places, as structured JSON with hex values, WCAG contrast notes and suggested pairings. Built for quick brand and interface work.

terms.licence: Use the palettes in any commercial or personal project. The dataset itself may not be republished as a competing product.
terms.deliverables: One JSON file, delivered at purchase.
terms.refunds: A download cannot be returned, so it is not refunded.

offers.name: Extended studio licence
offers.about: Upgrades any ACME single-studio purchase to an extended licence: unlimited machines, use in products for sale, and sub-licensing for one client. Issued as a signed licence document naming your studio.

terms.licence: Extended licence: unlimited machines within your studio, use in products for sale, and one named client sub-licence. Not transferable to another studio.
terms.deliverables: A licence document naming the studio given at purchase, delivered at purchase.
terms.scope: Covers all ACME products bought by the named studio before and after the licence date.

offers.name: Pitch kit for small studios
offers.about: A plain-English guide written after ninety pitches we mostly lost: how to scope a project, price it, and write the one-page pitch that gets read. Includes a follow-up email template and a fee calculator sheet.

terms.licence: For use within your own studio. You may share it internally; you may not resell or publish it.
terms.deliverables: One Markdown file, delivered at purchase.
terms.refunds: If the guide does not help, tell us within 14 days and we will refund it.
